description.et: Eesti kohalike tehniliste teenuste omaniku kinnitatud profiilid, mida AI-agendid saavad lugeda. Hinnapäringu koostab agent, kinnitab inimene. Prototüüp, ainult demoandmed.
description.en: Owner-verified profiles of local technical service companies in Estonia that AI agents can read. An agent drafts a quote request, a person confirms. Prototype, demo data only.

agent_may_not: send requests without the customer's approval
